title: 第11章 自讨苦吃第12章 你们敢杀我
content_zh:
入夜时分，王家内的一处密室中，三位聚气境修士正围坐在一起。
“可打探清楚了，他家家主真的在矿产上？”
身披虎皮的王家家主王雄问道。
“是的，我们派过去假装走错路的商队，亲眼看到杨贯峰在矿产去看护。”
坐在他左手边，王家第二高手王烈说道。
此人三十八岁，和杨贯峰年龄相仿，不同的是，杨贯峰这个岁数已经拥有聚气五重的中期境界，而此人还是个聚气二重。
“那这么说来，杨家现在寨子中，就只剩下了一个刚刚聚气不久的小娃娃？”
右侧的年轻修士开口道。
他是王雄的孩子王伟阳，王家的第三个聚气，今年十六岁，半年前突破的聚气。
“对，正是如此。”王烈说道。
二人看向家主王雄，等待着他的决定。
此前三人便商议过，不能让杨家过得这么舒服，必须给他们一些教训和警告。
但因为对方实力强于自身，想实施起来就比较困难。
不过眼下，他们知道了杨贯峰和余老都不在杨家的消息，便动起了心思。
“哼！也是敲山震虎的时候了，王烈，择日不如撞日，就今晚吧，你潜入杨家，吓唬吓唬他家里剩的那个小的，最好能让杨家把镇子上那老头召回去，这样他那几家商铺，便成不了气候。”
王雄思索一番后拍板道。
“没问题家主！”
王烈一听可是高兴坏了。
他已经许久没有与人斗法，之前连续几次吃瘪的经历让他耿耿于怀。
这次对上一个刚刚聚气的小娃娃，他也是终于有机会当一回狠狠羞辱弱者的强者了。

“叔叔，你一个人会不会有危险？要不我也和你一起去？”王伟阳问道。
王烈一听便摆手道：“伟阳，对付个刚破境不久的聚气一重，我一人足矣，况且两个人行动目标太大，容易被抓到马脚。”
王雄听罢也是点点头，赞同王烈的说法。
“家主，就放心交给我吧，保管这一夜过后，那杨家就得风声鹤唳草木皆兵！”
王烈拍着胸脯保证道。
这个可怜的家伙，此时还不知道，迎接自己的将会是什么。
当晚，王烈便穿着一身夜行衣，借着漆黑夜色的遮掩离开白石镇。
调转灵力全力奔跑下，只用了两个时辰，就到达了杨家寨的所在。
作为修士，他轻而易举的就绕过了杨家的护卫。
翻过院墙后直奔最深处。
来到后院没有发现修士修炼的迹象，正当他疑惑之际，抬眼看到了那处山崖。
“呵呵呵，有意思。”
content_en:
At night, in a secret room in the Wang family, three Qi Gathering monks were sitting together.
"But after finding out, the head of his family is really in the mining industry?"
Wang Xiong, the head of the Wang family wearing a tiger skin asked.
"Yes, the caravan we sent over to pretend to have gone the wrong way saw Yang Guanfeng guarding the mines with our own eyes."
Sitting on his left, Wang Lie, the second master of the Wang family, said.
This person is thirty-eight years old, similar in age to Yang Guanfeng. The difference is that at this age, Yang Guanfeng has already reached the middle stage of the fifth level of Qi gathering, while this person is still at the second level of Qi gathering.
"So, the only thing left in the Yang family's village is a little baby who has just gathered energy?"
The young monk on the right spoke.
He is Wang Xiong's child Wang Weiyang, the third Qi gatherer of the Wang family. He is sixteen years old this year and made a breakthrough in Juqi half a year ago.
"Yes, that's exactly it." Wang Lie said.
The two looked at the head of the family, Wang Xiong, waiting for his decision.
The three of them had discussed before that they could not let the Yang family live so comfortably and must give them some lessons and warnings.
But because the other party is stronger than itself, it is more difficult to implement it.
But now that they knew that Yang Guanfeng and Mr. Yu were not in the Yang family, they started to think about it.
"Hmph! It's time to knock on the mountain to shock the tiger. Wang Lie, it's better to hit the sun tonight. You sneak into the Yang family and scare the remaining little one in his family. It's best if the Yang family calls the old man back from the town, so that his few shops will not become a problem."
Wang Xiong thought for a while and then decided.
"No problem, Master!"
Wang Lie was very happy when he heard this.
He hadn't fought with anyone for a long time, and he was still haunted by the experience of being defeated several times in a row.
This time, facing a little kid who had just gathered his strength, he finally had the opportunity to be a strong man who severely humiliated the weak.
"Uncle, are you in danger alone? How about I go with you?" Wang Weiyang asked.
Wang Lie waved his hand as soon as he heard this and said: "Weiyang, I am enough to deal with a Qi-gathering first level who has just broken through. Besides, the target of two people's actions is too big and it is easy to be caught."
After hearing this, Wang Xiong nodded and agreed with Wang Lie's statement.
"Master, please feel free to leave it to me. After this night, the Yang family will be in a state of panic and chaos!"
Wang Lie patted his chest and promised.
This poor guy still doesn't know what will happen to him.
That night, Wang Lie wore night clothes and left Baishi Town under the cover of the dark night.
Turning around his spiritual energy and running with all his strength, he reached the location of Yangjiazhai in only two hours.
As a monk, he easily bypassed the Yang family's guards.
After climbing over the courtyard wall, go straight to the deepest point.
When he came to the backyard, he found no sign of the monks practicing. Just when he was confused, he looked up and saw the cliff.
"Hehehe, interesting."
